initialize_vision_module: initialize a pretrained vision module like resnet50 or vit and strip the classification head
get_model: get a pretrained torchvision or timm model by name such as resnet50 or swin
Sender: build a Sender neural network that encodes images into discrete messages using a vision backbone
Receiver: build a Receiver neural network that matches messages against distractor images using cosine similarity
PopulationGame: build a PopulationGame that samples sender-receiver-loss triples and computes auxiliary similarity loss
